theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_exists_smooth_unit_form_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → AEStronglyMeasurable g ν → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ K → g x = 0) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ h : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm h ∧ tsupport h ⊆ O ∧ (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (h z) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (h x - g x)) ∂ν < ENNReal.ofReal ε
